name: Cognitive Maze v2.0.0 - Dynamic Quiz Expansion, Visual Overhaul & Simplified UI
notes: Version 2.0.0 — Major Release: Dynamic cloud question synchronization supporting up to 15 stations with dynamic grading and score calculation; visual overhaul replacing overhead text badges with clean universal question mark beacons for unanswered NPCs, green checkmarks for correct answers, and red cross beacons for wrong answers; Objectives HUD and Character Completion status cards with prominent wrong answer indicators; Quarter 2 non-overlapping dialog window system; clean static barricade in Stage Select with zero per-frame allocation for smooth 60 FPS performance; strict terrain background layering ensuring game blocks never overlap floating graphics.
